sources.description: What the run walks: recursive and direct pins, and the MFS tree under mfs_root. Absent: the configured embeddings.bulk.sources.

mfs_root.description: MFS root the run descends from when sources includes mfs. Absent: the configured embeddings.bulk.mfs_root.

max_files.description: File cap for this run. The effective cap is the smaller of this and the configured embeddings.bulk.max_files_per_run; a run never exceeds the config cap. The cap counts files tried (files seen minus already_indexed, excluding not_a_file), so re-running over indexed content does not consume it.

max_bytes.description: Byte cap for this run. The effective cap is the smaller of this and the configured embeddings.bulk.max_bytes_per_run; a run never exceeds the config cap.

files_per_minute.description: Rate limit for this run. The effective rate is the smaller of this and the configured embeddings.bulk.files_per_minute; a run never exceeds the config rate.

resume.description: true resumes the paused run left behind by a restart (a new confirmation is asked); false starts a new run and fails with failed_precondition while a run is active or paused. Runs never resume by themselves (ADR-0011 V4).

confirm_token.description: Binding handle from a previous confirmation_required result. Accepted only after a human approved that confirmation (ADR-0003); omit on the first call.
